text:
alex: Leaving my shift, swapping to @jules. Quick watchlist for the night:
- KV prefetch alert spiked twice in the past hour (rules: kv-prefetch-high). I muted one duplicate rule in the rotation; left a note in the ops runbook.
- Encoder pool tail latency p95 ~320ms (no errors yet).
- Two short reroute failures to us-east-2: `Error: route not available` — looked transient, recovered after re-attach.
Logs/snippets:```
2024-06-12T21:03:11Z WARN kv-prefetch service=encoder node=enc-12 prefetched=0.01s spike=480ms
2024-06-12T21:12:02Z ERROR router-attach route=us-east-2 code=E_ROUTE_NOT_AVAIL
```
I didn't escalate because no customer-facing errors, but wanted to call these out as watchpoints. I'll leave the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/prefetch-runbook :eyes:

jules: Thanks — taking over. I'll keep canary traffic pinned to eu-west and watch the encoder p95. Can you point me to the runbook note you updated?

alex: Link above, section "rotation-mutes" — I added a timestamped entry and rationale. Also re-enabled the duplicate alert later after a quick tune; current kv-prefetch-high is dedup window=10m (was 1m).

marta: FYI there's an open PR that changes prefetch backpressure behavior (PR #451). If that lands it may reduce spikes but could surface a different alert. I can hold off merging until we confirm tonight's profile.

jules: Good call. @marta can you drop the PR link? I'll hold off merge until morning unless it clearly fixes the p95.

marta: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/451 — main change: add token-aware backoff; tests passing in staging but we didn't run long-tail load. :thumbsup:

sam: I noticed an encoder instance crashed in staging earlier with OOM; filed TICKET-783 to track. Not sure if it's related but worth flagging. https://tickets.redwood/TICKET-783

jules: Thanks @sam — assigning to infra triage. For oncall, I'll keep the temporary threshold and alert policy in place and notify if I see another reroute. If things escalate, we'll open a short postmortem even if no customer impact. :ok_hand:

infra-bot: alert policy updated by alex — kv-prefetch-high dedupe=10m (policy change id: ap-8921)

oncall-bot: shift swap recorded: alex -> jules (rotation id: rot-44). Next check-in at +2h.

jules: Quick checklist for anyone covering this thread: 1) watch kv-prefetch High metric (dashboard: /dashboards/kv-prefetch) 2) monitor encoder p95 via /dashboards/encoder-pools 3) if reroute error recurs, run `curl -XPOST https://internal-api/redwood/reroute/check?node=us-east-2` and paste output here.

alex: one last note — if you see a persistent p95 > 400ms, restore the older prefetch threshold and ping infra oncall. Otherwise, no customer pages expected. Good night all :wave:
